ieltsRotation.cadence: one suitably graded mini-task after each 3 completed teaching groups
ieltsRotation.status: proposed insertion contract, NOT registered or authored here
ieltsRotation.existingReusable: 8 registered lessons per exam category; reuse only after prerequisites and media QA. No duplicate work on other author batches.
ieltsRotation.firstChapter: After groups 3/6/9/12, build or choose a genuinely beginner-sized task; do not silently send a beginner to the harder hub/course material.

routeProposal.checkpoint: after each existing 12-group chapter: new same-level integrated task + separate delayed evidence; reuse existing project record but do not call a task instruction an authored test
routeProposal.supplements: NCE3/4 remain accessible; choose targeted remediation through same route, never require all four books before IELTS
